title: The Collision Spectrum
summary: For a prime base $b$ and primitive odd Dirichlet character $χ$ modulo $b^2$, the collision transform coefficient $\hat{S}^{\circ}(χ)$ admits an exact factorization: \[ \hat{S}^{\circ}(χ) = -\frac{B_{1,\overlineχ} \cdot \overline{S_G(χ)}}{φ(b^2)}, \] where $B_{1,\overlineχ}$ is the generalized first Bernoulli number and $S_G(χ)$ is the diagonal character sum. By the standard Bernoulli--$L$-value formula, $|B_1| = (b/π)\, |L(1, χ)|$, so the collision invariant's Fourier spectrum encodes $L$-function special values.
